You are almost there, the function arguments need to be passed on to the GGIR function directly:

GGIR(includedaycrit = 16,
qwindow = "C:/Users/blablablab//testh.csv",
qwindow_dateformat  ="%d-%m-%Y",
mvpathreshold = 100)
